description: This file defines data models, constants, and methods related to channels in the Mattermost server, including channel types, properties, validation, and utility functions.

classes.name: Channel
classes.description: Represents a communication channel with properties like ID, name, type, and metadata.

classes.name: ChannelBannerInfo
classes.description: Holds banner display information for a channel, including enabled status, text, and background color.

classes.name: ChannelWithTeamData
classes.description: Extends Channel with associated team display name, team name, and update timestamp.

classes.name: ChannelsWithCount
classes.description: Contains a list of channels with associated total count.

classes.name: ChannelPatch
classes.description: Used for updating channel properties such as display name, header, purpose, and banner info.

classes.name: ChannelForExport
classes.description: Represents a channel with additional export-related data like team name and scheme name.

classes.name: DirectChannelForExport
classes.description: Represents a direct message channel with its members for export purposes.

classes.name: ChannelModeration
classes.description: Defines moderation settings for a channel, including roles for guests and members.

classes.name: ChannelModeratedRoles
classes.description: Holds roles for guests and members within channel moderation.

classes.name: ChannelModeratedRole
classes.description: Specifies value and enabled status for a moderated role.

classes.name: ChannelModerationPatch
classes.description: Used to update moderation roles and settings.

classes.name: ChannelModeratedRolesPatch
classes.description: Partial update structure for moderated roles.

classes.name: ChannelSearchOpts
classes.description: Options for searching channels with filters like team IDs, deletion status, and access policies.

classes.name: ChannelMemberCountByGroup
classes.description: Tracks member count and timezone count for a group within channels.

classes.name: ChannelOption
classes.description: Function type for configuring channel properties.

classes.name: GroupMessageConversionRequestBody
classes.description: Request body structure for converting group messages.

classes.name: ChannelMembersGetOptions
classes.description: Parameters for retrieving channel members with pagination and update filters.

methods.name: Scan
methods.description: Scans database value into ChannelBannerInfo struct.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Converts ChannelBannerInfo struct into a database-storable value.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of channel properties for auditing.

methods.name: LogClone
methods.description: Returns a clone of the channel's audit data.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the channel's data integrity and constraints.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Prepares the channel object before saving, generating ID and timestamps.

methods.name: PreUpdate
methods.description: Updates timestamps and sanitizes fields before updating.

methods.name: IsGroupOrDirect
methods.description: Checks if the channel is a group or direct message type.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the channel is an open channel.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Applies a patch to update channel properties.

methods.name: MakeNonNil
methods.description: Ensures Props map is initialized.

methods.name: AddProp
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to Props.

methods.name: IsGroupConstrained
methods.description: Checks if the channel is group constrained.

methods.name: IsShared
methods.description: Checks if the channel is shared.

methods.name: GetOtherUserIdForDM
methods.description: Returns the other user ID in a direct message channel.

methods.name: GetBothUsersForDM
methods.description: Returns both user IDs in a direct message channel.

methods.name: Sanitize
methods.description: Returns a sanitized version of the channel.

methods.name: MarshalJSON
methods.description: Serializes ChannelType to JSON.

methods.name: GetDMNameFromIds
methods.description: Generates a DM channel name from two user IDs.

methods.name: GetGroupDisplayNameFromUsers
methods.description: Creates a display name for a group from user list.

methods.name: GetGroupNameFromUserIds
methods.description: Generates a unique group name from user IDs.
